Here are some of the latest news highlights about **NVIDIA** as of **June 2024**:

### **1. NVIDIA Surpasses Microsoft & Apple to Become World’s Most Valuable Company**
   - **Date:** June 18, 2024
   - **Details:** NVIDIA briefly overtook **Microsoft** and **Apple** to become the **world’s most valuable company** (market cap ~$3.34 trillion) due to surging demand for its AI chips. However, it later slipped back to second place.
   - **Source:** [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/)

### **2. NVIDIA’s Next-Gen AI Chips: **Rubin (2026) & Blackwell Ultra (2025)**
   - **Date:** June 2024 (Computex 2024)
   - **Details:**
     - **Blackwell Ultra (B100)** – Expected in **2025**, an upgraded version of the **B200** with higher performance.
     - **Rubin (R100)** – Set for **2026**, succeeding Blackwell with even more advanced AI capabilities.
     - **NVLink 6** – New interconnect tech for faster GPU communication.
   - **Source:** [NVIDIA Blog](https://blogs.nvidia.com/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/)

### **3. NVIDIA’s AI-Powered Robotics & Humanoid Robots**
   - **Date:** June 2024
   - **Details:**
     - NVIDIA unveiled **Project GR00T**, a general-purpose AI model for humanoid robots.
     - Partnered with **Figure AI, Boston Dynamics, and Tesla Optimus** to accelerate robotics development.
     - Introduced **Isaac Sim**, a simulation platform for training robots in virtual environments.
   - **Source:** [NVIDIA News](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/)

### **4. NVIDIA’s AI-Powered PC Push with RTX AI Laptops**
   - **Date:** June 2024 (Computex)
   - **Details:**
     - NVIDIA announced **RTX AI laptops** with **RTX 40-series GPUs** optimized for **local AI processing** (e.g., Copilot+ features).
     - Partners include **ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, and MSI**.
     - **RTX AI Toolkit** helps developers optimize AI models for PCs.
   - **Source:** [NVIDIA Developer Blog](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/)

### **5. NVIDIA’s AI Supercomputers Powering Global Data Centers**
   - **Date:** June 2024
   - **Details:**
     - **Taiwan’s National Center for High-Performance Computing (NCHC)** deployed an **NVIDIA-powered AI supercomputer**.
     - **France’s Jean Zay supercomputer** upgraded with **NVIDIA H100 GPUs** for AI research.
     - **Microsoft, Google, and Meta** continue expanding NVIDIA-based AI infrastructure.
   - **Source:** [NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/)

### **6. NVIDIA’s Stock Split & Investor Updates**
   - **Date:** June 7, 2024
   - **Details:**
     - NVIDIA completed a **10-for-1 stock split**, making shares more accessible to retail investors.
     - Stock surged **~200% in 2024** (YTD) due to AI demand.
   - **Source:** [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/)

### **7. NVIDIA’s Omniverse & Digital Twin Expansion**
   - **Date:** June 2024
   - **Details:**
     - **Omniverse Cloud APIs** now available for enterprises to build **digital twins** (virtual replicas of physical systems).
     - Used in **automotive, manufacturing, and smart cities**.
   - **Source:** [NVIDIA Omniverse](https://www.nvidia.com/omniverse/)

### **8. NVIDIA’s AI for Healthcare & Drug Discovery**
   - **Date:** June 2024
   - **Details:**
     - **NVIDIA BioNeMo** (AI for drug discovery) now supports **generative AI models for protein folding**.
     - Partnered with **Amgen, Recursion, and Insilico Medicine** for AI-driven drug development.
   - **Source:** [NVIDIA Healthcare](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/healthcare/)

---
### **Where to Find More Updates?**
- **Official NVIDIA News:** [NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/)
- **Stock & Financials:** [NVIDIA Investor Relations](https://investor.nvidia.com/)
- **AI & Tech News:** [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/), [Wired](https://www.wired.com/), [Tom’s Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/)
